args.content: Working definition: the 'primary region' is the region with the highest gross revenue (sum of the `amount` column, over completed orders only, i.e. status = 'completed') in memory.bench.orders. Operationally: filter memory.bench.orders to completed orders, join/group by customer region (via memory.bench.customers.region on customer_id, since region is not a column on orders itself), SUM(amount) per region, and take the region with the max total. Note: this uses gross amount (not amount - discount); contrast with the 'leading region' definition (region with most orders by count) and the Revenue Reporting Policy (net revenue = amount - discount) which is a different metric.
